notes: Prototype: away-team movement and formations for exploration. Videogame adaptation, not from the books; every number here is implementation tuning.
Distances are in map tiles (1 = one tile). Positions are continuous, with tile centres at whole numbers.
Formation slots: x = to the leader's right, y = behind the leader. The first slot is the leader; followers take the others. Slots are scaled by the party's spacing and turned to the leader's heading.
Every party member walks at the same speed: no character stat is used for exploration movement yet.

Walk or run (designer decision, 2026-10-09): a move order to a point more than runDistance from the lead character runs at runSpeed, otherwise walks; while the button is held this follows the cursor. Followers of a running leader run too, and catch up at runCatchUpSpeed.

formations.name: Diamond
formations.description: General purpose: the leader in front, two on the flanks and one at the rear.

formations.name: Line
formations.description: Side by side, for wide open spaces.

formations.name: Column
formations.description: One behind another, for corridors and narrow places.

formations.name: Tight
formations.description: Close together, where space is limited.

formations.name: Spread
formations.description: Wide spacing, for tactical positioning and keeping clear of hazards.
